newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Sulzer to keep 75 pct of Medica unit.
newsitem.headline: Sulzer to keep 75 pct of Medica unit.

text.p: Doris Schurdak, manager of investor relations for Sulzer Technology Corp said the company would retain around 75 percent of its Medica unit following the plan to sell-off some 25 percent of Medica to the public.
"Sulzer will maintain about 75 percent," Schurdak said, referring to Medica.
"There are no plans at the moment to sell anymore (than about 25 pct)," she added.
Earlier today Sulzer said it would sell off around one-fourth of Medica in a public placement during this year.
Schurdak said there would be no furher information for the time being on the price of shares or where these would be listed.
"We have to work out the figures ourselves," she said, referring to the equity value and the share price.
